data.title: 金色暗影 · 遮阳伞下的海风鲷鱼烧
data.description: 海滨木棚的遮阳阴影下，金色暗影端正地坐在沙滩折叠椅上，双手小心捧着一只热腾腾的鲷鱼烧细口咬下。哑光黑系带泳装衬得金发与雪肤愈发耀眼，发现你在偷看时她微微鼓起脸颊，低声抛出一句「我讨厌色情」，手里的点心却没舍得放下。
data.location: 海滨木质遮阳棚下的清凉沙滩椅
data.action: 端坐折叠椅双手捧着鲷鱼烧轻咬，微嗔斜睨镜头
data.lighting: 棚下柔和散射光与背后明亮海滩日光形成清爽层次
data.camera: 平视中景，展现海面蓝天与俏皮反差神情
data.promptProse: Seated neatly in a folding chair beneath a shaded seaside cabana, Golden Darkness holds a warm taiyaki with both hands and takes a careful bite. Her matte-black string bikini contrasts vividly with her golden hair and pale skin as she shoots a mildly guarded side glance at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Sitting in the cabana shade with bright ocean behind her, she nibbles a taiyaki while glancing sideways with a slight pout.
